messages:
sre-bot: :rotating_light: Incident created: 2459998888 - Peregrine Analytics (private/VPC) auth failures on dedicated pool

sre-bot: paging oncall @lexa (severity: high) — more than one tenant reporting 401s to control-plane API and management traffic failing TLS handshake

lexa: I'm on it — joining bridge. quick ask: is this limited to Peregrine or broader VPC fleet?

omar: I see 5xx->401s in the control-plane logs for tenant peregrine-01 from our dedicated gateway. tcpdump shows TLS handshake failures with peer cert verify errors (verify failed: certificate unknown).

priya: Customer reported this at 11:12 UTC: their IDP rotated the signing cert an hour ago. they said rotating JWKS propagated but then their egress rules changed from their infra team.

sam_account: Confirmed with Peregrine support: they rotated their OIDC signing key and updated JWKS, but then ran a firewall change to block egress to our JWKS mirror IPs. They assumed our control plane would fallback to cached keys.

nina: Impact: Their dedicated pool CPU is fine but management-plane auth calls (tenant config fetch, cert handshake) are failing when contacting Peregrine IDP JWKS. User-facing inference is degraded for that tenant because routing requires validated tokens.

lexa: Triage summary: control-plane can't validate new tokens because it can't fetch the new keys (JWKS) from customer IDP due to egress block on customer's side. Our JWKS cache TTL was 5m and expired during the rotation window.

ops-lead: Paging sequence: we need short-term customer workaround + infra mitigation to avoid global impact. @omar can you confirm whether we have a recent snapshot of Peregrine's JWKS in any region?

omar: Searching backups... found a cached JWKS in our regional mirror from 10m ago (peregrine-jwks://mirror/eu-west-1/peregrine-01.json). It has the old kid and the new kid was missing. If we force use of that cache it will still reject new tokens.

lexa: Can we apply a temporary relaxed validation that accepts tokens signed by old kid and skips kid check for this tenant? We prefer not to relax crypto broadly.

omar: We have an emergency per-tenant flag in the control-plane: auth.jwks_validation_mode: strict|lenient|mirror-only. Setting to mirror-only will trust our current mirror copy and fall back to it rather than fetching. Risk: if customer completely rotated and removed old key, new tokens may be rejected until they re-sign with an existing key.

priya: Customer said they still sign some tokens with the old key during a grace period. So mirror-only should let traffic pass while they fix their egress.

lexa: OK do it. Omar, document the change and deploy to peregrine-01 only. Use canary on one node first.

omar: Running kubectl patch on control-plane deployment peregrine-01-auth-ctrl:

```
kubectl -n control-plane patch deployment peregrine-01-auth-ctrl \
  -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"auth.jwks_validation": "mirror-only"}}}}}'
```

omar: Canary applied to one replica. Observability: auth failures dropped 80% on that node. Will roll to remaining replicas in 5m if stable.

peregrine-support-bot: Peregrine infra team inbound: they confirm firewall rule accidentally blocked 3rd-party IPs used for our JWKS endpoint. They are reverting now. ETA 3-7m.

nina: Customer impact update: internal customer dashboards show request success rate from 24% -> 92% after the canary change. Some long-lived tokens still failing (those minted after full rotation).

lexa: Good. Next: we should push a temporary JWKS mirror of the customer's current published JWKS (we pulled before egress blocked) into our local mirror with the new key if we can obtain it via their support channel.

omar: I pulled the customer's new jwks.json from their support ticket and put it in the mirror path /mirror/eu-west-1/peregrine-01/new-jwks.json. Applying mirror sync now and bumping mirror TTL to 6h for safety.

omar: Mirror sync complete. Rolling restart of auth-ctrl started to pick up new local jwks.

priya: After mirror and restart, we're seeing 100% success for token validation on canary, rolling to 3/3 replicas now.

sam_account: Peregrine confirmed their egress rule rollback completed and they validated connectivity to our mirror IPs. They will keep it open for 24h while we confirm stability.

ops-lead: Good. We should revert the per-tenant lenient flag once we confirm JWKS mirror sync + egress stable. Plan: keep mirror-only for 30m after full roll then revert.

lexa: I'll monitor for 30m and then flip back. Also need an oncall handoff note for night shift. @ops-lead please add runbook updates and postmortem owner.

ops-lead: Assigning postmortem to @omar and account follow-up to @sam_account. Action items: 1) add explicit play for egress-blocking IDP rotations 2) increase default JWKS cache TTL to 15m with per-tenant override 3) implement alert for repeated JWKS fetch failures (>=3 fetch errors in 10m)

nina: Recording customer update: Peregrine wants a short incident summary and assurance we'll add caching/alerting. They are requesting a follow-up call tomorrow.

lexa: Handoff to night oncall @nova (in case of regressions). Leaving bridge in 15m.

sre-bot: :white_check_mark: incident 2459998888 marked resolved by lex a at 2459999200. Summary: JWKS fetch failures due to customer egress rules after key rotation. Mitigation: per-tenant mirror-only mode + manual JWKS mirror + customer egress rollback. Postmortem and runbook updates assigned.

omar: Postmortem notes I'll include: timeline of rotation, metrics (auth success rates by node), code snippets for emergency mirror, and the customer remediation checklist.

sam_account: I'll schedule the customer call and share the postmortem draft. Thanks everyone. :heart:

ops-lead: Follow-up backlog created: JWKS caching config, fetch-failure alert, per-tenant emergency switches documented. Closing incident once postmortem is published.

lexa: Leaving final note: do not flip mirror-only globally; only per-tenant in emergencies. We almost made a mistake there earlier.

peregrine-support-bot: Peregrine team: thanks for the quick response. We'll add a hold-open period on their firewall changes for future key rotations.

sre-bot: Incident closed.
